name: 藕粉撕纸粘毛滚家务款

shots.intent: 首屏用高位右上的柔差冷光把整支工具的真实结构一次立清：握柄闭环与挂孔、双叉轴帽、自由转动的纸卷各自归位，靠一条短而紧的左下投影与一件真实软体家具锚住尺度
shots.textZone: upper-left headline stack on the chalk plane, one short line above a perforation dot-rule, three hexagon keyline tags along the lower left

shots.intent: 用一张高角度俯视把毛衣、靠垫与毯面上扫不净的毛发浮毛摆到眼前，残屑真实附着在织物绒面上，只用一条孔线问句提问而不给任何结论
shots.textZone: one headline on the header band plus three short question labels set along one perforation dot-rule under the photograph

shots.intent: 同毯面同机位同光双联，把推过一道的痕迹与纸上带走的残屑并置，用可见的附着证据替掉任何吸除率与百分比
shots.textZone: short header across the top plus one caption per panel and two empty option ticks along a perforation dot-rule

shots.intent: 把这张页面最核心的机制讲清楚：沿孔线起离用过的纸面、露出干净新面，靠一只手的真实受力与纸的挺度说服人，不写任何层数与粘性断言
shots.textZone: two dot-leader labels at the perforation row and the fresh face plus one short headline above

shots.intent: 把滚头为什么能自由转、握柄为什么不打滑这两件看不见的事落到轴帽、叉臂、握纹与挂孔的真实做工上，用掠射光读零件而不下任何断言
shots.textZone: one headline above the frame plus two dot-leader labels at the axle cap and the hanging hole

shots.intent: 在真实沙发场景中演示推一道的动作：鼓面压进绒面、毛发被带到纸上并留在纸上，用姿态与残屑替掉一粘就没式断言
shots.textZone: upper-left headline and one sub-line above a perforation dot-rule, three hexagon keyline tags along the bottom

shots.intent: 一张正俯视平铺把针织衫、绒毯与坐垫三个可作业面交代清楚，三个真实残屑状态并排而不堆参数，用尺与挂绳等日常物做尺度参照
shots.textZone: one headline along the lower left plus three short surface labels set along one perforation dot-rule

shots.intent: 三段同光掠射微距沿一条孔线竖排，把纸的卷边、轴帽咬合与握柄挂孔的真实做工摆在一起，让耐用落在可见零件而不是任何断言上
shots.textZone: vertical ladder of three hexagon numeral tags and three labels on the left rail, one headline above the stack

shots.intent: 正立视线的选款轨把整支工具、两种宽窄不同的替换纸卷与三个手柄配色并排交代，规格行一律空置，替掉原页不可复用的参数表
shots.textZone: one header on the sedge band, four empty spec rows with dot leaders, three colour ticks and two width ticks along a perforation dot-rule

shots.intent: 最后一屏用同一束右上高光和一条孔线收住整套叙事，一处六边形孔线按钮引导下单，不承诺任何优惠数字与功效
shots.textZone: left closing line block plus one soft hexagonal keyline button in the lower left

style.presentationRules: the tool keeps its real build in every screen: one moulded ergonomic handle with a closed-loop grip and a hanging hole at the handle end, a row of finger ridges on the front face of the grip, a stippled texture patch at the neck underside, two open curved yoke arms dropping from the handle front and ending in round axle caps, and a free-turning paper sheet roll seated between those caps; the sheet roll surface reads as #F4F2EC wound paper with a real diagonal ply seam and an open end showing the card core #B07C4A, never as a sponge, a gel block, a bristle brush head, a looped-yarn head or a metal drum; the refill rolls keep their real proportions and the difference in head width between the two rolls stays as the reference shows it; the reference has no stand, no base, no lid, no clip, no wall hardware and no cutter of any kind, so none appears; handle colourways stay exactly as the reference and are never recoloured into the campaign palette; the drum always meets the surface it cleans along a real contact line with the paper edge visibly compressed, never hovering and never leaving a gap; vertical lines stay vertical and nothing is cropped at the base; people appear only as an anonymous cropped forearm or cropped hand gripping the handle, never a face, never a child, never a bare palm touching the used adhesive face; no animal is groomed, held, brushed or shown mid-frame anywhere; a lifted hair or lint is always carried away on the used face of the sheet or left as a thin line of debris ahead of the drum, never dissolving and never vanishing in mid-air
